about: What tools/build_latest.ps1 builds: the newest playable state. The orchestrator keeps this current as branches land; every listed merge is checked to be conflict-free when it changes. Branch names are without origin/; paths are relative to unity/.
contents: The G7 player on the test range at physics model 44: menu (Train, Calibrate, Exit, Explore), setup (the houses' start only), the TX12 calibration, flights from the track (legs on) or the D02 launch stand (legs off); the D01 drone with the bottle by payload, the airframe's effects, the rotors' interference, the micro-motion near the ground, the published power and mass build, the computed landing, Betaflight's yaw I, and the class's ESC braking on disarm; props that chip, trim, break and jam on walls and objects (p7f), listed in the summary; the map's wind with its wakes and the trench's shelter; wet and saturated soil and straw in rain, the straw's area laws; the fiber line's payout, pull and trail, drawn, and the coil shrinking with payout; S04's straw drawn at a distance; the pilot's FpvPrep rates and throttle curve; R restarts, C turns the camera's noise off, X shows the stick overlay, small under the craft's name and following the sticks every field (D-084), the OSD's throttle middle right; the analog feed and OSD, V for first or third person, pause, the summary and the flight log. Not yet: props on soil, leg damage (p7g), vegetation on the legs and props, soft wires, prop blur, the weather look; most tree crowns are passable stand-ins.
